segments.title: Chương 267: 0269【Sohu cũng tham gia】
segments.content:
Li Yanhong didn't just leave directly; he was having an urgent call of nature and went to the restroom.

But he took quite a while in there. It wasn't until several minutes after Chen Guiliang's speech had ended that Li Yanhong slowly returned to the main forum hall.

"Mr. Li, can we get an exclusive interview?"

"CEO Li, what are your thoughts on Mr. Chen Guiliang's speech?"

"Boss Li, Chen Guiliang pointed out several errors in your speech. Do you have any rebuttals?"

"CEO Li, about the ranking issue Chen Guiliang mentioned. Do you have any explanation?"

After the main forum concluded, Li Yanhong was instantly swarmed by reporters.

"Sorry, I'm not giving interviews. Please make way," Li Yanhong said, walking straight for the exit as his assistants helped clear a path through the crowd.

Even without the Chen Guiliang incident, Li Yanhong wouldn't have accepted any interviews today.

Because every single one of the media outlets these reporters represented had collectively denounced Baidu two months ago over the layoff scandal.

If Li Yanhong accepted an interview, the reporters would inevitably bring up Baidu's layoff scandal again.

Now that Chen Guiliang had unexpectedly jumped into the fray, the reporters had even forgotten about the layoff scandal, because a fresher, juicier scoop was right in front of them.

Seeing Li Yanhong push his way through the crowd, the photojournalists quickly snapped pictures of his retreating back.

They could still write a story even without an interview.

The headline could be: Chen Guiliang's Refutation is Well-Founded, Li Yanhong is Left Speechless.

After Li Yanhong left, the reporters swarmed over to Chen Guiliang's side.

Chen Guiliang was currently surrounded by new internet tycoons. Seeing the reporters join the commotion, everyone engaged in an even friendlier exchange.

"Hello, Mr. Chen, I'm a reporter from Sohu's tech channel." During the layoff scandal two months prior, Sohu had been a major force in criticizing Baidu. How could they possibly miss this opportunity?

Chen Guiliang smiled and nodded. "Hello."

"Mr. Chen, why do you think Mr. Li's speech contained so many basic errors?" the Sohu reporter asked.

Chen Guiliang appeared poised and exceptionally magnanimous. "Actually, I can understand Mr. Li. He said he was so busy preparing his speech last night that he didn't sleep well. When a person is sleep-deprived, their mind isn't as sharp, and it's perfectly normal to talk nonsense. I suggest that next time he attends an event, he gets enough sleep before coming, to avoid giving people the impression that he's not all there."

"Hahaha!"

The reporters and new internet tycoons standing nearby all burst out laughing at his words.

That was just too vicious, insulting someone without a single curse word.

A reporter from *China Internet Weekly* asked, "CEO Chen, you mentioned the search results for Legends of the Three Kingdoms, where the official website appeared after the ads. Do you think this is a reasonable practice?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I don't wish to comment on other companies' business strategies. But I would suggest that Baidu does a better job of screening its ads. If a scammer pays enough in advertising fees, will their link also be ranked at the very top of the search results? A common scammer just cheats people out of money, but someone selling fake medicine could be robbing them of their life and fortune! My Xiaonei and Hainei networks resolutely refuse to accept pharmaceutical ads. We'd rather earn less money than take them. A person has to have a bottom line, and so does a business."

A reporter from *China Computerworld* asked, "Mr. Li said that the Web 2.0 model has insufficient profitability. Do you agree with this view, Mr. Chen?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I admit that profitability is insufficient at this stage, and I also admit that investment is a bit overheated. But why is investment overheated? Are venture capital firms all idiots? It's overheated because it has potential! I've only seen people fighting over food, never over shit. As for insufficient profitability, were the profit models of those Web 1.0 websites sufficient? Weren't they also making money from online games and wireless value-added services?"

"Because profitability is insufficient at this stage, it has no future, and so we should give up? That's not being rational, that's cutting off one's nose to spite one's face! Even an idiot can see that Web 2.0 is the trend in internet development; it's impossible to go back to the 1.0 era."

"Mr. Li's pessimism about Web 2.0 reminds me of the strange things carriage drivers used to say when automobiles first appeared. The carriage drivers pointed out all sorts of flaws in automobiles, mocking those who rode in or drove them as fools. It's obvious who the real fools are. Perhaps some people aren't foolish, but are just pretending to be!"

"Let me put it this way, Baidu Tieba is one of the most successful Web 2.0 products today. Having created such a successful Web 2.0 product, Baidu should be managing it diligently, not bad-mouthing its own creation!"

"I don't know how the product president and product managers of Baidu Tieba will react when they hear Mr. Li's speech today. We subjects are ready to fight to the death, why has Your Majesty surrendered?"

This statement sent the whole crowd into laughter.

Facing the numerous cameras, Chen Guiliang said in a very sincere tone, "To all the mid-level and senior managers at Baidu, if you're ever unhappy working at Baidu, I at ByteDance and Game Science will welcome you anytime."

This made the reporters laugh even harder. They took Chen Guiliang's words as just another way to needle Li Yanhong.

Baidu was currently an internet behemoth. The number of people they laid off this year alone was more than half of ByteDance's total employee count.

Baidu's senior executives would jump ship to ByteDance and Game Science?

What a joke.

But who could have predicted that starting from December this year, a slew of Baidu's top executives, including the CTO, CFO, and COO, would successively resign over the next two to three years.

Not a single one would be left!

When reporters later interviewed Li Yanhong and asked why all of Baidu's top executives had left.

Li Yanhong didn't answer directly, only saying, "That was the hardest year for me, especially around the 2008 Spring Festival... I was in the most pain. I reflected on it for a while, thinking I must have done something wrong..."

Regardless of Jack Ma's character, one thing he said was very true: employees only resign for two reasons. They're not paid enough, or they feel wronged.

Baidu's executives certainly weren't short on money, so why did they all resign within a short span of two or three years, leaving not a single one behind?

Chen Guiliang spent over ten minutes with the reporters. It was only after all the reporters had gone to interview other entrepreneurs that he and the new internet tycoons went to find a place for coffee.

Just as they were leaving the venue, a person suddenly approached them.

Sohu's boss, Zhang Chaoyang, had arrived!

Starting this year, Sohu's CEO had been handling external affairs, with the CEO attending all sorts of events, including today's internet conference.

As for Zhang Chaoyang himself, he had been mingling in the entertainment circle and was currently rumored to be involved with the international star Zhang Ziyi.

Zhang Chaoyang hadn't attended the internet conference today. His sudden appearance definitely meant something had drawn him here.

What had drawn him here?

The answer was already obvious.

"Haha, Xiao Chen, interested in grabbing a drink?" Zhang Chaoyang took the initiative to greet Chen Guiliang.

Seeing this, Chen Guiliang couldn't help but think: *Is your grudge with Li Yanhong really that deep? I dissed him two hours ago, and you rushed over here to join the fun. Even when Zhou Hongyi and Lei Bus challenged each other to a fight, they weren't this quick.*

The public opinion war between Sohu and Baidu had raged from mid-July all the way to early September, only completely subsiding a little over half a month ago. During that time, they had slung mud at each other, using every trick in the book.

Chen Guiliang said, "A reporter from Sina is supposed to do an exclusive interview with me in a bit. It was arranged this morning."

Zhang Chaoyang smiled. "No problem, I'll wait for you. I watched Sohu's live text and photo feed of your speech today. It was brilliant. I drove over an hour just to get back here."

The new internet tycoons standing nearby couldn't help but chuckle when they heard Zhang Chaoyang's words.

This really was a grudge match.
